meanings.en: a famous person or thing seen as representing an idea or era
meanings.exampleEn: She became a fashion icon in the 1960s.
meanings.exampleTr: 1960'larda bir moda ikonu hâline geldi.

meanings.en: very cold or covered with ice
meanings.exampleEn: The icy road made driving dangerous.
meanings.exampleTr: Buzlu yol araba kullanmayı tehlikeli hâle getirdi.

meanings.en: in the best possible way; if things were perfect
meanings.exampleEn: Ideally, we would finish the project by Friday.
meanings.exampleTr: İdeal olarak, projeyi cuma gününe kadar bitirirdik.

meanings.en: exactly the same
meanings.exampleEn: The twins wore identical dresses.
meanings.exampleTr: İkizler birbirinin aynısı elbiseler giydi.

meanings.en: the act of recognizing someone or something, or an official document proving who you are
meanings.exampleEn: You need some form of identification to enter the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Binaya girmek için bir tür kimlik belgesine ihtiyacınız var.

meanings.en: to recognize and name someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Can you identify the man in this photograph?
meanings.exampleTr: Bu fotoğraftaki adamı teşhis edebilir misin?

meanings.en: a set of beliefs, especially political or economic ones
meanings.exampleEn: The party's ideology shaped its economic policies.
meanings.exampleTr: Partinin ideolojisi, ekonomik politikalarını şekillendirdi.

meanings.en: a stupid or foolish person
meanings.exampleEn: I felt like an idiot for forgetting my keys again.
meanings.exampleTr: Anahtarlarımı yine unuttuğum için kendimi bir aptal gibi hissettim.

meanings.en: not working or being used; lazy
meanings.exampleEn: The machines stood idle during the strike.
meanings.exampleTr: Grev sırasında makineler atıl durumda kaldı.

meanings.en: to admire or love someone very much
meanings.exampleEn: Many young fans idolize the singer.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok genç hayran şarkıcıyı taparcasına seviyor.

meanings.en: a lack of knowledge or information
meanings.exampleEn: His mistakes were caused by ignorance, not malice.
meanings.exampleTr: Hataları kötü niyetten değil, cahillikten kaynaklanıyordu.

meanings.en: not knowing about something; lacking knowledge
meanings.exampleEn: He was completely ignorant of the local customs.
meanings.exampleTr: Yerel gelenekler konusunda tamamen bilgisizdi.

meanings.en: to explain with examples, or to add pictures to a text
meanings.exampleEn: This example helps illustrate the main point.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu örnek, ana fikri açıklamaya yardımcı oluyor.

meanings.en: a picture in a book, or an example that explains something
meanings.exampleEn: The book is full of colorful illustrations.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap renkli resimlerle dolu.

meanings.en: the use of vivid descriptive language or pictures
meanings.exampleEn: The poem is rich in imagery of the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir, deniz imgeleriyle zengindir.

meanings.en: a copy of something, or the act of copying
meanings.exampleEn: The painting is just a cheap imitation of the original.
meanings.exampleTr: Tablo, orijinalin sadece ucuz bir taklidi.

meanings.en: to put something deep into a liquid, or to involve yourself deeply
meanings.exampleEn: She likes to immerse herself in her work.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini işine kaptırmayı sever.

meanings.en: a person who comes to live permanently in another country
meanings.exampleEn: Many immigrants settled in the city looking for work.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok göçmen iş arayarak şehre yerleşti.

meanings.en: not following accepted standards of right behavior
meanings.exampleEn: Lying to your friends is immoral.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşlarına yalan söylemek ahlaksızcadır.

meanings.en: living or lasting forever
meanings.exampleEn: In the myth, the gods were immortal.
meanings.exampleTr: Efsanede tanrılar ölümsüzdü.

meanings.en: the state of living or being remembered forever
meanings.exampleEn: The ancient kings dreamed of immortality.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski krallar ölümsüzlüğün hayalini kurardı.

meanings.en: treating everyone equally; not favoring one side
meanings.exampleEn: A judge must remain impartial at all times.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir hâkim her zaman tarafsız kalmalıdır.

meanings.en: in a way that shows a lack of patience
meanings.exampleEn: She waited impatiently for the bus to arrive.
meanings.exampleTr: Otobüsün gelmesini sabırsızca bekledi.

meanings.en: something that is essential, or the verb form used for commands
meanings.exampleEn: Reducing pollution is an environmental imperative.
meanings.exampleTr: Kirliliği azaltmak çevresel bir zorunluluktur.

meanings.en: not lasting forever; temporary
meanings.exampleEn: Happiness can feel impermanent during hard times.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor zamanlarda mutluluk geçici gibi hissedilebilir.

meanings.en: a possible effect or result, or something suggested indirectly
meanings.exampleEn: The new law has serious implications for small businesses.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasanın küçük işletmeler için ciddi sonuçları var.

meanings.en: not polite; rude
meanings.exampleEn: It is impolite to interrupt people when they are speaking.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar konuşurken sözlerini kesmek kabalıktır.

meanings.en: in a rude or discourteous way
meanings.exampleEn: He behaved impolitely toward the waiter.
meanings.exampleTr: Garsona karşı kabaca davrandı.

meanings.en: to officially force a rule, tax, or punishment on someone
meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to impose a new tax on imports.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükûmet, ithalata yeni bir vergi koymaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: the fact of something not being able to happen
meanings.exampleEn: Traveling faster than light remains an impossibility.
meanings.exampleTr: Işıktan hızlı seyahat etmek bir imkânsızlık olarak kalıyor.

meanings.en: not sensible or realistic to do or use
meanings.exampleEn: Wearing high heels on a hike is impractical.
meanings.exampleTr: Yürüyüşte topuklu ayakkabı giymek pratik değildir.

meanings.en: feeling admiration for something good
meanings.exampleEn: I was very impressed by her presentation.
meanings.exampleTr: Sunumundan çok etkilendim.

meanings.en: a style of painting that captures the impression of light and moment
meanings.exampleEn: Monet was a leading figure in impressionism.
meanings.exampleTr: Monet, izlenimciliğin önde gelen isimlerinden biriydi.

meanings.en: an artist who paints in the impressionist style
meanings.exampleEn: The museum displays works by famous impressionists.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, ünlü izlenimcilerin eserlerini sergiliyor.

meanings.en: to put someone in prison
meanings.exampleEn: The court decided to imprison him for ten years.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme onu on yıl hapsetmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: the state of being kept in prison
meanings.exampleEn: He was sentenced to five years' imprisonment.
meanings.exampleTr: Beş yıl hapis cezasına çarptırıldı.

meanings.en: not likely to be true or to happen
meanings.exampleEn: It seems improbable that they will finish on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Zamanında bitirmeleri pek olası görünmüyor.

meanings.en: in a way that is wrong or not suitable
meanings.exampleEn: The device was installed improperly and stopped working.
meanings.exampleTr: Cihaz yanlış bir şekilde kuruldu ve çalışmayı durdurdu.

meanings.en: made better than before
meanings.exampleEn: The new model has an improved battery life.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni modelin geliştirilmiş bir batarya ömrü var.

meanings.en: a sudden strong urge to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She bought the dress on impulse.
meanings.exampleTr: Elbiseyi ani bir dürtüyle satın aldı.

meanings.en: acting suddenly without thinking carefully
meanings.exampleEn: His impulsive decision cost him a lot of money.
meanings.exampleTr: Fevri kararı ona çok paraya mal oldu.

meanings.en: not correct or exact
meanings.exampleEn: The report contained several inaccurate figures.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor birkaç yanlış rakam içeriyordu.

meanings.en: not enough or not good enough
meanings.exampleEn: The funding was inadequate to finish the project.
meanings.exampleTr: Finansman, projeyi bitirmek için yetersizdi.

meanings.en: not alive; lacking life
meanings.exampleEn: A rock is an inanimate object.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir taş cansız bir nesnedir.

meanings.en: existing in a person from birth; natural
meanings.exampleEn: She has an inborn talent for music.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzik için doğuştan gelen bir yeteneği var.

meanings.en: a substance burned to produce a sweet smell
meanings.exampleEn: The temple was filled with the smell of incense.
meanings.exampleTr: Tapınak tütsü kokusuyla doluydu.

meanings.tr: (borç, masraf vb.) altına girmek, maruz kalmak
meanings.en: to experience something unpleasant as a result of your actions
meanings.exampleEn: You may incur extra charges if you cancel late.
meanings.exampleTr: Geç iptal ederseniz ek ücretlere maruz kalabilirsiniz.

meanings.en: impossible to cure or treat
meanings.exampleEn: At that time, the disease was considered incurable.
meanings.exampleTr: O dönemde hastalık tedavi edilemez olarak görülüyordu.

meanings.en: very grateful, or owing money
meanings.exampleEn: I am deeply indebted to my teachers for their support.
meanings.exampleTr: Destekleri için öğretmenlerime derinden minnettarım.

meanings.en: to start a line of text further from the margin than the others
meanings.exampleEn: Remember to indent the first line of each paragraph.
meanings.exampleTr: Her paragrafın ilk satırını içeriden başlatmayı unutmayın.

meanings.en: on your own, without help or control from others
meanings.exampleEn: The children learned to work independently.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar bağımsız olarak çalışmayı öğrendi.

meanings.en: too extreme or unusual to be described
meanings.exampleEn: The view from the mountain was indescribable.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağdan görünen manzara tarif edilemezdi.

meanings.en: an alphabetical list at the end of a book, or a measure of something
meanings.exampleEn: Look up the topic in the index at the back of the book.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuyu kitabın arkasındaki dizinden arayın.

meanings.en: not interested in or concerned about something
meanings.exampleEn: He seemed indifferent to the suffering of others.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkalarının acısına karşı kayıtsız görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a situation that makes you feel embarrassed or loses you respect
meanings.exampleEn: He suffered the indignity of being fired in public.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin önünde kovulmanın onur kırıcılığını yaşadı.

meanings.en: so important or useful that you cannot manage without it
meanings.exampleEn: A good dictionary is indispensable for language learners.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi bir sözlük, dil öğrenenler için vazgeçilmezdir.

meanings.en: to allow yourself or someone else to enjoy something pleasant
meanings.exampleEn: On weekends I like to indulge in a long breakfast.
meanings.exampleTr: Hafta sonları uzun bir kahvaltıya kendimi bırakmayı severim.

meanings.en: allowing someone to have or do what they want, often too much
meanings.exampleEn: Her indulgent parents gave her everything she asked for.
meanings.exampleTr: Şımartan ailesi, istediği her şeyi ona verdi.

meanings.en: to develop industries in a country or region
meanings.exampleEn: The country began to industrialize in the nineteenth century.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke on dokuzuncu yüzyılda sanayileşmeye başladı.

meanings.en: not producing the desired result
meanings.exampleEn: The treatment proved ineffective against the virus.
meanings.exampleTr: Tedavi, virüse karşı etkisiz çıktı.

meanings.en: not moving or not reacting chemically
meanings.exampleEn: Helium is an inert gas that rarely reacts.
meanings.exampleTr: Helyum, nadiren tepkimeye giren atıl bir gazdır.

meanings.en: not having much knowledge or skill from doing something
meanings.exampleEn: The young driver was still too inexperienced for the highway.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç sürücü otoyol için hâlâ çok deneyimsizdi.

meanings.en: a very young child or baby
meanings.exampleEn: The infant slept peacefully in his mother's arms.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebek, annesinin kollarında huzur içinde uyudu.

meanings.en: to give someone a disease or to contaminate something
meanings.exampleEn: The virus can infect people through close contact.
meanings.exampleTr: Virüs, yakın temas yoluyla insanlara hastalık bulaştırabilir.

meanings.en: containing harmful bacteria or a virus
meanings.exampleEn: The wound became infected and needed treatment.
meanings.exampleTr: Yara enfekte oldu ve tedavi gerektirdi.

meanings.en: able to be passed from one person to another
meanings.exampleEn: The flu is a highly infectious disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Grip, oldukça bulaşıcı bir hastalıktır.

meanings.en: a conclusion reached from evidence and reasoning
meanings.exampleEn: From her smile, I made the inference that she was happy.
meanings.exampleTr: Gülümsemesinden, mutlu olduğu çıkarımını yaptım.

meanings.en: a red, swollen, and painful area of the body
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor prescribed cream to reduce the inflammation.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor, iltihabı azaltmak için krem reçete etti.

meanings.en: likely to cause anger, or relating to inflammation
meanings.exampleEn: His inflammatory speech provoked the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Kışkırtıcı konuşması kalabalığı tahrik etti.

meanings.en: to fill with air or gas, or to increase in amount
meanings.exampleEn: He used a pump to inflate the tires.
meanings.exampleTr: Lastikleri şişirmek için bir pompa kullandı.
